brandbook.positioning: Estudio ficticio de yoga y pilates en Cali para encontrar una práctica consciente y reservar con claridad. Cuatro clases de ejemplo, dos salas y cuatro instructoras ficticias; una experiencia cercana sin credenciales, contactos o promesas inventadas.
brandbook.voice: Español sereno, cercano y concreto: «Encuentra tu práctica» y «Reserva tu espacio». Explicar saldo, espera y cobro presencial con claridad. Una advertencia breve por página identifica la demostración; los errores indican cómo recuperarse sin lenguaje técnico innecesario.
brandbook.motif: Dos líneas de respiración que se abren desde una base horizontal sólida. Delimitan una esterilla vectorial y ritmos abstractos propios de cada práctica; esa base reúne selección y acción y continúa en configuración, revisión y confirmación. Sin cuerpos, rostros ni supuestas instalaciones.

pages.title: Brand Values
pages.summary: Use calm, clarity and continuity as proposed design principles, not asserted corporate values. Demonstrate them through spacing, explicit states and an unchanged session context.

examples.title: Calm
examples.text: One selected practice, one adjacent specification and one primary action; no competing promotional panels.

examples.title: Clarity

examples.title: Continuity
examples.text: Keep Pilates control visible from its schedule row through review, conflict and confirmation.

pages.title: Tone of Voice
pages.summary: Write public copy in calm, direct Spanish using tú. Prefer specific verbs and short recovery messages. Avoid mystical claims, medical benefits, urgency and invented reassurance.

pages.title: Logo overview
pages.summary: The identity pairs an original two-line symbol with a real typographic name. The shared base signals continuity; the open upper field suggests breath without depicting a body or building.

examples.title: Name treatment
examples.text: Set Raíz in Manrope 600. Preserve the acute accent over í and keep the four letters clearly separated.

examples.title: Two assets
examples.text: The SVG contains only geometry. Render Raíz as typography beside it, never as an improvised replacement path.

pages.title: Primary logo
pages.summary: Use a horizontal lockup for navigation and stationery. Align the symbol’s optical center with Raíz; keep the optional descriptor beneath the name, never inside the symbol.

examples.title: Header lockup
examples.text: At a 40 px symbol canvas, set Raíz at 28 px with a 12 px gap. Keep the header near 52 px high on compact mobile screens.

examples.title: Descriptor
examples.text: Raíz / Yoga y pilates — use Source Sans 3 for the smaller descriptor and omit it when space is limited.

pages.title: Logo Safezone
pages.summary: Define one clearance unit as the symbol’s base thickness. Leave at least two units around its visible geometry and the full lockup; the SVG canvas is not a crop guide.

examples.title: Navigation spacing
examples.text: Separate the Raíz lockup from Inicio by at least two clearance units; do not use the empty opening as space for a menu icon.

examples.title: Colored support
examples.text: On Hoja or Tinta, extend the Niebla support beyond the safezone. Preserve both upper tips and the complete base.

pages.title: Color combinations
pages.summary: Keep the master symbol Hoja. Use it directly on Niebla or place it on a Niebla support over colored fields. Use Tinta on Lima for actions and Niebla on Hoja for reversed text.

examples.title: Light header
examples.text: Niebla field, Hoja symbol and Tinta Raíz wordmark; reserve Lima for Ver horario y reservar.

examples.title: Dark chapter
examples.text: Hoja field with Niebla text and a Niebla-backed symbol. Do not recolor the symbol to create a reversed version.

pages.title: Brandmark
pages.summary: Reuse the exact SVG geometry for standalone recognition. The two curved bands meet a horizontal base; do not add a letter, a lotus, a person or the practice mat to the core mark.

examples.title: Standalone use
examples.text: Use the complete symbol for the app icon, favicon and social avatar; keep Raíz nearby in larger contexts.

examples.title: Mark versus scene
examples.text: The homepage may add a mat and practice rhythms as a separate illustration. Those elements never become part of the logo.

pages.title: Logo misuse
pages.summary: Preserve proportions, palette and open space. Never stretch the bands, remove the base, clip the tips or use the symbol as a mask for imagery.

examples.title: Incorrect name
examples.text: Do not write Raiz, RAIZ or Ráiz as the brand name. The correct business name is Raíz.

examples.title: Incorrect decoration
examples.text: No terracotta gradients, enclosed initials, shadows, lotus additions or controls placed across the symbol.

pages.title: Typography
pages.summary: Use this divider to introduce a clean sans-serif system. Set the title in Manrope and supporting copy in Source Sans 3; let scale and space create elegance instead of ornamental lettering.

examples.title: Espacio para tu práctica
examples.text: Yoga y pilates. Elige una clase y consulta sus próximas sesiones.

examples.title: Divider treatment
examples.text: Use a short two-line heading on Lima with Tinta text; keep at least 40 px before the supporting sentence.

pages.title: Typography overview
pages.summary: Manrope leads names and headlines; Source Sans 3 carries reading and controls. Supplied distributable files cover the selected weights. Local hosting is the planned delivery method.

examples.title: Encuentra tu práctica
examples.text: Compara nivel, duración y tarifa ilustrativa antes de elegir una sesión.

examples.title: Family pairing
examples.text: Set Encuentra tu práctica in Manrope 600 and its explanation in Source Sans 3 400. Use a system sans-serif only as a loading fallback.

pages.title: Primary typeface
pages.summary: Use Manrope for Raíz, headlines and key quantities. Keep headings brief with −0.035em tracking; do not compress long schedule details into display typography.

examples.title: Vuelve a tu raíz
examples.text: Encuentra tu práctica y reserva tu espacio.

examples.title: Display specimen
examples.text: Set the hero at 72 px on desktop and 36 px on phone, weight 600. Break after Vuelve when the available width requires it.

pages.title: Typography
pages.summary: Use Manrope 500–600 for the website and 700 for Constructor manual headings. Source Sans 3 uses 400 for reading, 500 for labels and 600 for actions. Prefer upright styles.

examples.title: Revisa tu reserva
examples.text: Comprueba la clase, la hora y la sala antes de confirmar.

examples.title: Weight specimen
examples.text: Revisa tu reserva: Manrope 600. Sala Semilla: Source Sans 3 500. Confirmar reserva: Source Sans 3 600.

examples.title: Style restraint
examples.text: Use weight, not italics or all caps, to distinguish Pago presencial pendiente from its explanation. Never synthesize extra-bold lettering.

pages.title: Supporting type
pages.summary: Use Source Sans 3 for paragraphs, schedules, fields and status text. Body and inputs stay at least 16 px, navigation 14 px and secondary labels 12 px.

examples.title: Yoga suave
examples.text: Inicial · 60 min · $30.000 COP · Tarifa ilustrativa

examples.title: Readable data
examples.text: Align schedule times and occupancy figures consistently. Use tabular numerals for comparisons without shrinking explanatory labels.

pages.title: Hierarchy
pages.summary: Order each view as context, main decision, specification and action. Use a compact 36/24/16/12 px scale on phone; private references remain secondary to human-readable results.

examples.title: Reserva confirmada
examples.text: Tu cupo está confirmado. Consulta los detalles y el estado vigente en Mis clases.

examples.title: Result hierarchy
examples.text: Lead with Reserva confirmada, then the saved class details, then Mis clases. Place the private reference below at secondary size.

pages.title: Layouts
pages.summary: Use an 8/16/24/40/64 px spacing rhythm and broad horizontal planes. Keep forms in normal flow; interior pages use compact scenes, never a repeated full-height hero.

examples.title: Reserva tu espacio
examples.text: Revisa tu sesión y completa tus datos.

examples.title: 390 × 640 study
examples.text: Budget about 52 px for header, 44 for title, 128 for scene, 100 for the shared base and 120 for the first field group.

examples.title: Continuous composition
examples.text: Place the selected class above its fields with a 24 px gap. Avoid split heroes, repeated cards and floating action docks.

pages.title: Colors
pages.summary: Use Lima as the chapter field and Tinta for its title. Introduce the palette with one broad Hoja band rather than equal-size decorative swatches.

examples.title: Una base compartida
examples.text: Niebla opens the space; Hoja anchors it; Lima draws attention to the next deliberate action.

examples.title: Divider composition
examples.text: Keep the Raíz symbol on Niebla and reserve the largest uninterrupted area for Lima.

pages.title: Colors overview
pages.summary: Preserve all six supplied tokens. Niebla is the background, Hoja the surface, Lima the accent, Tinta the text and Jade the muted role; Advertencia is an additional semantic token.

examples.title: Core planes
examples.text: Niebla #F3F6F2 · Hoja #173E35 · Lima #D5E69A. Use Niebla for reading areas and Hoja for the shared action base.

examples.title: Text and states
examples.text: Tinta #192621 · Jade #347264 · Advertencia #944219. Pair warnings with explicit text, never color alone.

examples.title: Action pairing
examples.text: Confirmar reserva uses Tinta on Lima. On Hoja surfaces, use Niebla for supporting text rather than muted Jade.

pages.title: Using Tints
pages.summary: Keep semantic colors at their exact hex values. Restrict transparent Jade decoration to Niebla fields; text, focus indicators and control borders must retain readable contrast.

examples.title: Quiet rhythm
examples.text: A 12% Jade breathing line may sit behind an empty margin, not behind Yoga suave or any input label.

examples.title: Control distinction
examples.text: Use a solid Jade border around a Niebla field. A Lima button on Niebla needs a contrasting boundary, not a pale tint alone.

pages.title: Graphic Elements
pages.summary: Extend the open bands into a horizontal conceptual scene with a vector mat. Keep the base fixed when selection changes; move bands for 280 ms, or apply changes instantly with reduced motion.

examples.title: Yoga references
examples.text: Yoga suave uses broad, spaced waves. Yoga fluido uses one continuous trajectory. Neither diagram gives anatomical instructions.

examples.title: Pilates references
examples.text: Pilates fundamentos uses parallel support lines. Pilates control uses precise intervals. Preserve each class’s reference throughout booking.

examples.title: Motion restraint
examples.text: Use one brief entrance and selective reveals. Keyboard selection gets the same result; no ambient loops or directed scrolling.

pages.title: Icons
pages.summary: Use simple 24 px line icons with consistent 2 px strokes. Pair transactional icons with labels, provide 44 px targets and keep decorative breathing lines out of the control vocabulary.

examples.title: Schedule controls
examples.text: Pair a left arrow with Semana anterior and a right arrow with Semana siguiente. Give icon-only mobile controls equivalent accessible names.

examples.title: State distinction
examples.text: Reserva confirmada uses a check and text; En espera uses a clock and text. Never identify these states by green versus orange alone.

pages.title: Photography
pages.summary: This project uses no photographs or image files. Replace photographic roles with conceptual SVG diagrams, color planes and typographic instructor plates; do not show portrait placeholders.

examples.title: Instructor plate
examples.text: Ana · Ver sesiones — use the name and a derived curve, with no portrait, biography or invented credential.

examples.title: Practice scene
examples.text: A simplified vector mat sits inside the breathing field. It represents a practice concept, not the layout of a real studio.

pages.title: Moodboard
pages.summary: Build a material board from the proposed system itself, not borrowed wellness photography. The image-free direction is an adaptation to this project’s constraints, not an approved external reference.

examples.title: Selected direction
examples.text: Líneas de respiración: open bands, a fixed base, Manrope headlines, Source Sans 3 details and a Niebla field.

examples.title: Contrast references
examples.text: Atlas corporal suggests mapping; patio de luz suggests planes and voids. Keep these as process concepts, not alternate public identities.

examples.title: Exclude
examples.text: No cream/serif/terracotta wellness formula, posed bodies, stock foliage, imitation interiors or image-loading states.

pages.title: Applications
pages.summary: Design studies: carry the same base, open geometry and concise Spanish across each format. These layouts propose applications; they do not establish implemented features or real merchandise.

examples.text: Explora las clases, consulta el horario y revisa tu elección.

examples.text: Place the symbol alone on the chest or tote center. Put the typeset name in a separate lower position, outside the symbol safezone.

pages.summary: Design study: adapt the packaging chapter to a printed class-information sleeve. Use a practice rhythm and clear metadata; do not imply merchandise, bundled equipment or anatomical guidance.

pages.title: Reservation controls
pages.summary: Design study for /reservar: use 44 px targets, 0.5rem corners and persistent labels. Review replaces editable controls with one specification. The final verb must distinguish booking from waiting.

examples.text: Se descontará un crédito al confirmar tu cupo.

examples.title: Review behavior
examples.text: Revisar preserves values and focuses the first error. A changed session requires explicit review; never switch the class or confirm optimistically.

pages.title: Reservation record
pages.summary: Design study for /confirmacion: display only the authorized server result. Lead with its exact outcome, retain the saved specification and separate later operational changes from the original record.

examples.title: Reserva confirmada
examples.text: Tu cupo está confirmado. Consulta la especificación guardada y el estado vigente en Mis clases.

examples.title: Paquete acreditado
examples.text: Tus clases se han acreditado. El pago presencial sigue pendiente.

pages.title: Class balance
pages.summary: Design study for /mis-clases: replace rewards-card language with real package credits. Separate balance, pending payment, reservations and waiting; never imply points, membership or added expiry.

examples.title: Tu saldo de clases
examples.text: Cada reserva confirmada utiliza un crédito. La espera no lo descuenta.

examples.title: Cancelar reserva
examples.text: Antes del inicio puedes cancelar y recuperar un crédito. Confirma la cancelación para liberar tu cupo.

examples.title: Updated states
examples.text: Show server-derived amounts only. Refresh promotions in Mis clases; leaving the waitlist changes no balance and sends no external notification.

pages.summary: Design study: adapt restaurant signage to a yoga and pilates studio. Use the horizontal Raíz lockup with a small descriptor; keep the symbol on Niebla when the sign field is Hoja.

examples.text: Yoga y pilates

examples.title: Sign hierarchy
examples.text: Make Raíz readable before the descriptor. Use flat palette colors and clear space; show no invented facade, street number or opening hours.

pages.title: Booking website
pages.summary: Design study: connect the nine planned screens through one selection and stable navigation. Availability and private results require real persistence; on data failure, show recovery rather than fabricated success.

examples.title: Ver horario y reservar
examples.text: Consulta las sesiones por disciplina, nivel e instructora. Las clases llenas siguen visibles con opción de espera.

examples.title: Public route family
examples.text: /, /clases, /horario, /instructoras, /paquetes and /mis-clases form the public navigation. Keep /duena discreet and its records private.

examples.title: Decision route family
examples.text: /reservar and /confirmacion also serve their identifier-based links. Preserve context; Dueña groups occupancy, attendees, waiting, schedule and collections.

pages.title: Favicon
pages.summary: Design study: derive favicon and app icons from the same master SVG, not a redrawn miniature. Use a Niebla support and preserve the full opening; omit all wordmark text.

examples.title: Small-size treatment
examples.text: Use the complete 160 × 160 geometry for app/icon.svg and related icons. Center it consistently; do not thicken one branch or close the opening.

pages.title: Stationery
pages.summary: Design study: use a restrained header and a lower breathing-line rule. Keep body copy in Source Sans 3 with generous margins; never decorate a document with invented legal or contact details.

examples.title: Paquetes para tu práctica
examples.text: 4 clases · $110.000 COP / 8 clases · $200.000 COP / 12 clases · $270.000 COP. Precios ilustrativos.

examples.text: La compra acredita tus clases de inmediato y deja el pago presencial pendiente. Los créditos no tienen caducidad añadida.
